verification.note: Reproduced by reading the test. In frontend/src/__tests__/uploadQueueRefresh.test.tsx:98-106 the test builds `before` with four counts but asserts `toBeGreaterThan(0)` only for recipes (104), series (105) and search (106). It never checks `before.other`. Line 121 then asserts `listingsFor(api, "other", DRIVE_ROOT)` toBe `before.other`. If the other-drive view never fetched, or if the DRIVE_ROOT predicate (line 68, `!p.path`) stopped matching the call's shape, both counts would be 0 and line 121 would pass without testing anything. In the current code, FolderBrowser with no folderPath reaches useFolderFiles.ts:204-210 with `path: folderPath`, which is undefined, so the predicate should match and the count is probably above 0. Nothing in the test enforces that. The I12 test (lines 146-158) has the same gap for `before.other`.

specification_compliance: The I8 test covers same-drive refresh with lower bounds. Its negative check for another drive is not guarded against a zero baseline.
regression_risks: If FolderBrowser's listing-call shape for the drive root changes, for example to `path: ""`, DRIVE_ROOT would still match. If it skips the fetch altogether, the other-drive assertion would pass without testing anything.
test_coverage: uploadQueueRefresh.test.tsx I8: same-drive refresh is asserted with lower bounds. The other-drive non-refresh lacks a positive baseline (line 101 is never asserted). The search non-refresh has a baseline (line 106).
not_verified: Did not run the test suite, so whether before.other is actually above 0 at runtime is unverified.
